verdict.rationale: Proa components are written in typed Rust. The template macro is validated at compile time, and editor tools add hover, completion, and go-to-definition inside templates. Together these imply component props are type-checked from their Rust definitions without separate annotations. Nothing documents inference for emitted events or event handler payloads, and nothing frames props typing as inference rather than explicit Rust field types. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prop type inference at component usage sites, typed or inferred emitted events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
